AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: EasyTV is an Android TV IPTV app for live channels, series, and movies. Operational Patterns: - For 'pon el partido X', 'dónde echan X', or a match/team query: call playLiveByQuery. First resolve likely broadcasters from the web if needed, then pass them as channelHints (e.g. DAZN, M+ LaLiga) together with the match query so EasyTV can match the user's playlist. - For 'pon Antena 3' or 'pon la 5': call playChannel with the name or number. - For 'abre series' / 'películas' / 'tele': call openMode. Constraints: - Requires a seeded playlists.json on the device. - Channel and program matching is against the user's IPTV list and short EPG only. - Prefer channelHints from web search when the user asks for a match without naming the channel.
